title: 轮转数组
statement: 给定整数数组 nums 和非负整数 k，把数组元素整体向右轮转 k 个位置（最右边的元素移到最左边，重复 k 次）。要求原地修改 nums，核心函数不返回值，系统检查修改后的数组。

en.title: Rotate Array
en.statement: Given an integer array nums and a non-negative integer k, rotate the array to the right by k positions (move the rightmost element to the leftmost position, repeated k times). Modify nums in place; the core function returns nothing, and the system checks the modified array.

complexity.space: O(1) extra space (three reversals or cyclic replacement)
complexity.officialRequirement: Official follow-up: come up with as many solutions as you can (at least three), and try to do it in place with O(1) extra space.
complexity.notes: n is the array length; k may exceed n, so take k mod n first. Three reversals: reverse the whole array, then reverse the first k and the last n-k elements separately. Copying into a new array (O(n) extra space) is correct but does not meet the follow-up; shifting right one step at a time, O(n·k), times out on large tests. The largest local test has 50000 elements (official limit is 100000, reduced to keep the problem bank small, since both input and output are stored in it).

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 has n and k; line 2 has n integers nums. stdout: one line with the n integers after rotation.

complexity.space: O(1) 额外空间（三次翻转或环状替换）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方 follow-up：尽可能想出至少三种解法，并尝试用 O(1) 额外空间原地完成。
complexity.notes: n 为数组长度，k 可能大于 n，先取 k mod n。三次翻转：整体翻转，再分别翻转前 k 个与后 n-k 个。复制到新数组 O(n) 额外空间结果正确但不满足 follow-up；每次右移一位的 O(n·k) 做法在大测试上会超时。本地最大测试为 50000 个元素（官方上限 100000，为控制题库体积而缩小，输入和输出都要写入题库）。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 n 和 k；第二行 n 个整数 nums。stdout：一行，轮转后的 n 个整数。
